target.body:
## Summary

- add persistent Codex and Claude panel defaults with explicit per-reviewer model and effort selection
- retry Fable once on refusal, then allow an explicit Opus max fallback
- add isolated Bedrock profile routing while keeping provider credentials outside model-controlled process tools
- incorporate and harden the useful cpt-dev-master isolation work

## Validation

- scripts/validate-skills
- autoreview --self-test
- repository script tests and Python compile checks
- final Codex xhigh plus Claude Fable max panel: clean
- local Python suite: 249 passed, 1 skipped; 4 JVM-home assertions require a local JRE and were not installed for this change
